candidates.name: Tally
candidates.testQuestion: Can the free plan support a credible client intake and handoff without creating avoidable admin?
candidates.nextAction: Run the standard intake-to-handoff test and record limits, setup time, and failure points.

candidates.name: Salesforce Free Suite
candidates.testQuestion: Is the free suite usable for a small service business without expert configuration?
candidates.nextAction: Run the standard lead-capture and follow-up test with a new workspace.

candidates.name: Wix Symphony
candidates.testQuestion: Can Symphony replace a bounded Wix Custom Agent task without weakening approvals, auditability, export, or cost predictability?
candidates.nextAction: Run the same follow-up and morning-report jobs in legacy Custom Agent and new Symphony accounts; compare scopes, approvals, logs, export, credits, and recovery.

candidates.name: Make Maia
candidates.testQuestion: Can a nontechnical owner create and safely maintain a useful workflow?
candidates.nextAction: Create a bounded lead-routing workflow and record setup, recovery, and monitoring requirements.

candidates.name: Cal.com mobile workflow
candidates.testQuestion: Does Individual Free reliably support two event types, two calendars, payments, mobile management, export, and custom reminder workflows without an unexpected paywall?
candidates.nextAction: Run the complete solo scheduling test and record every entitlement, workflow paywall, export path, notification, payment state, and deletion result.

candidates.name: Docusign in ChatGPT
candidates.testQuestion: Does the released integration shorten agreement preparation without weakening review or auditability?
candidates.nextAction: On or after September 30, reverify general availability, then use three dummy agreements to test retrieval scope, renewal detection, NDA preparation, approval gating, activity history, revocation, and export.

candidates.name: HighLevel and Jotform workflows
candidates.testQuestion: Can the native HighLevel connection replace a working Zapier or webhook handoff without creating incomplete or misleading Jotform records?
candidates.nextAction: In a non-production workspace, run a normal lead, signed agreement, required unsupported field, and payment form through the integration; verify values, payment state, duplicates, failure visibility, revocation, and export before removing the existing handoff.

candidates.name: HighLevel Chat Widget spam protection
candidates.testQuestion: Can Tag Only identify obvious chat spam without flagging normal, duplicate, or campaign-spike inquiries?
candidates.nextAction: On a test widget, enable Tag Only; submit normal, duplicate, malformed, rapid, and legitimate burst entries; verify tags, activity history, restoration, and false positives before allowing any channel pause.

candidates.name: HubSpot connector for ChatGPT
candidates.testQuestion: Can the connector reduce CRM admin without bypassing rules, creating duplicates, or granting more data access than the job requires?
candidates.nextAction: Run five dummy create and update cases covering duplicates, required fields, invalid stages, missing associations, and normal changes; verify preview, approval, attribution, rollback, export, and revocation.

candidates.name: Webflow MCP maintenance workflow
candidates.testQuestion: Can an owner or operator safely complete recurring Webflow maintenance through MCP without uncontrolled production access or hidden Designer dependencies?
candidates.nextAction: Test one GSAP interaction, a filtered CMS update, a localized-item failure, permission review, revocation, and agent-instruction export on a non-production site.
